pitch: app-live builds an Expo app locally with EAS and installs it onto whichever device you name — a physical device on your machine or a BrowserStack App Live cloud device. Ships as both an MCP server and a CLI.
challenge: Making device routing invisible: one build_and_install call detects whether the named device is local — picking the right installer (devicectl / simctl / adb) — or falls back to BrowserStack, without the caller knowing where the device lives.
